scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run --filter @safeory/web build && bun run --filter @safeory/extension build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @safeory/contracts typecheck && bun run --filter @safeory/web typecheck && bun run --filter @safeory/extension typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter @safeory/contracts lint && bun run --filter @safeory/web lint && bun run --filter @safeory/extension lint
scripts.test:browser: bun run --filter @safeory/contracts test && bun run --filter @safeory/web test && bun run --filter @safeory/extension test && bun run test:wasm
